name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
region_note: DOMESTIC-VIOLENCE PET SUPPORT - national hotline and shelter finder, from the Mayor's Alliance domestic violence page
notes: Free and confidential, answered at any hour. Also offers live chat and text on its website. Its own site warns that internet use can be monitored; if that is a risk, call instead.
type_raw: National hotline for people experiencing domestic abuse - call, text or chat
